product.name: Tranqui Negociador
product.description: An online platform to monitor and negotiate overdue debts with financial entities, offering options to reduce debt payments and improve cash flow.

product.name: Tranqui Finanzas
product.description: A financial advisory service providing personalized education and guidance to manage debts, recover credit scores, and remove negative credit reports.

product.name: Tranqui Diagnóstico
product.description: A tool to assess current financial status by reviewing debts reported to credit bureaus, credit scores, and credit history.

product.name: Financial Education Blog
product.description: An online resource offering articles and advice on financial education, debt management, and saving strategies.
